name: NAS Oceana
tagline: Home to 19 Navy fighter and attack squadrons, inside the Virginia Beach city limits.
_note: Navy air station inside Virginia Beach city limits (Hampton Roads, VA), with Dam Neck Annex. BAH MHA VA298 (Norfolk/Portsmouth). Housing: Liberty Military Housing (985 homes in five communities, shared with six other bases). Schools: Virginia Beach City Public Schools for most families, Chesapeake Public Schools for Chesapeake; no DoD schools in Hampton Roads. Medical: Oceana Branch Medical Clinic (no ER); NMC Portsmouth has the only military ER on the Southside. Corrected 2026-11-14 from Military OneSource, the Code of Virginia, City of Virginia Beach, Virginia Tax, VDOE, DeCA and REIN (page-builder research/oceana-facts.md). Virginia is TRICARE East. Gate names other than the main gate and gate hours are unverified (CNIC pages refuse automated readers). Medium-confidence flags: base coords (approx), off-base ZIP 23454.

sections.title: Mission & Identity
data: Naval Air Station Oceana, inside the Virginia Beach city limits, is home to 19 fighter and attack squadrons, with about 10,500 active-duty sailors, 10,000 family members and 4,500 civilians (Military OneSource). Jet noise is a live local issue, and Virginia Beach City Council has backed bringing newer jets such as the F-35 (WTKR).
It's part of the Hampton Roads military region, with Naval Station Norfolk and JEB Little Creek nearby, in a large coastal city known for its Atlantic beaches.

data.subtitle: Virginia law requires sellers to disclose whether a home is in a noise zone or accident potential zone, and Virginia Beach requires written disclosure to buyers and renters of property inside those zones. We suggest checking the zone for any address first, then choosing a school division and a commute.
intro: The disclosure must name the specific zone, as shown on the official zoning map (Code of Virginia, section 55.1-704). In Virginia Beach, new homes built in noise zones of 65 Ldn (a day-night average noise level) or higher must include noise reduction.

Beyond the zones, the choice is the school division and the drive. In the state's 2025-26 results, 61 of Virginia Beach's 81 schools and 36 of Chesapeake's 45 rated Meets Expectations or Distinguished. Virginia Beach's real estate tax is $0.97 per $100 of assessed value for fiscal 2027 and Chesapeake's $1.01.

recommendations.advice: Green Run and Salem are about 14 to 16 minutes from the main gate area on Tomcat Boulevard (estimates, no traffic). Ask for the noise and accident potential zone disclosure for any address.
The oceanfront is lively and busier in summer. Check the flood zone and the noise zone, and the city's short-term rental rules if you might rent the home out later.

Kempsville and Great Neck are about 19 to 20 minutes from the main gate area, and Chesapeake's Greenbrier and Great Bridge about 27 to 30 (estimates, no traffic). Check the zoned school for any address.
Liberty Military Housing runs 985 homes in five communities on and off base; Liberty serves Oceana and six other nearby bases. Waits depend on rank, date of application and bedroom entitlement.

sections.title: Gates & Access
data: Military OneSource's directions say to take I-264 east to Exit 21A at First Colonial Road, and to turn right on Tomcat Boulevard to reach the main gate (base address 1750 Tomcat Blvd.). Dam Neck Annex has its own main gate at the end of Dam Neck Road. On arrival, report to the Quarterdeck, Building 230 on Tomcat Boulevard, staffed 24 hours (757-433-2366).
We couldn't confirm gate hours or visitor rules from an official page, so check them with the base before guests arrive. There's no base transportation.

sections.title: On-Base Housing
data: Liberty Military Housing (formerly Lincoln) runs 985 homes in five communities on and off base, serving Oceana and six other nearby bases, by Liberty's count. Liberty says it takes no deposits and includes average utility costs in rent.

The Housing Service Center is at 1596 Tomcat Blvd., Building 280, open Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 4 p.m., closed weekends and holidays (www.cnic.navy.mil/OceanaHousing). Waits depend on rank, date of application and bedroom entitlement, and an advance application uses your detachment date as its control date.

sections.title: Schools
data: Military OneSource's Naval Station Norfolk page says there are no DoD or private schools on any installation in the Hampton Roads region. Oceana is inside Virginia Beach, served by Virginia Beach City Public Schools, and Chesapeake Public Schools serves Chesapeake addresses. In the state's 2025-26 results, 61 of Virginia Beach's 81 schools and 36 of Chesapeake's 45 rated Meets Expectations or Distinguished; Virginia Beach's Class of 2026 on-time graduation rate was 97%.
Your assigned school depends on your address, and the School Liaison can confirm the division and school: 875 D Avenue, Building 531, 757-433-2496, Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

source.label: Virginia School Quality Profiles, Virginia Beach

intro: Whether to rent or buy is the biggest money decision of most PCS moves, and in military-heavy Hampton Roads many sailors return to the area, which makes buying worth a look.
rent: Your tour is short (about two years or less) or your sea-duty rotation feels uncertain.
You want time to learn the area and pick the right part of the city.
You'd rather not gamble on resale timing when you PCS out.
Typical rents are $2,098 in Virginia Beach and $2,063 in Chesapeake (Zillow, September 2026), below E-5 BAH with dependents ($2,430).
buy: You expect a longer tour or repeat Hampton Roads assignments, which are common.
You want to use your VA loan and build equity instead of paying rent.
You've checked the noise zone, the flood zone and the schools for the exact address.
You've found a neighborhood and commute you're confident about.
data.bottom_line: There is no universal right answer. REIN reported the most homes for sale in Hampton Roads since April 2020 in September 2026, and Zillow's typical home value rose 3.1% in Virginia Beach over the year. Get the noise-zone and flood disclosures before you make an offer, run your BAH against the rent and home prices above, and talk to a lender and an agent who work with military families before you commit.

intro: The first month at a new duty station is mostly logistics. Knocking these out early makes everything else easier.

steps.title: Line up temporary lodging
steps.text: Book the Navy Inn on base or a short-term rental before you arrive. You can claim Temporary Lodging Expense (TLE) for a limited number of days while you house-hunt.

steps.title: In-process and update DEERS
steps.text: Report to your command and finance, and make sure DEERS and ID cards are current for every family member so TRICARE and base access work.

steps.title: Start with the Housing Office
steps.text: Apply through the Housing Service Center (www.cnic.navy.mil/OceanaHousing); advance applications use your detachment date. Ask for the noise and accident potential zone disclosure before you sign anything off base.

steps.title: Sort base access and your vehicle
steps.text: If you're a service member whose legal residence is another state, Virginia Beach and Chesapeake can exempt your car from the yearly car tax when you give the city a current Leave and Earnings Statement each year (Chesapeake's form is due by March 1); a spouse's vehicle needs its own form. Learn the visitor process for guests.

steps.title: Enroll the kids in school
steps.text: Call the School Liaison (757-433-2496), then contact Virginia Beach City Public Schools or Chesapeake Public Schools early and bring records and immunizations.

steps.title: Set up healthcare
steps.text: Update your TRICARE enrollment so you can be seen at the Oceana clinic or Naval Medical Center Portsmouth.

data.a: Military OneSource says Oceana is home to 19 fighter and attack squadrons. Virginia Beach City Council has backed bringing newer jets such as the F-35 (WTKR).

Across Virginia Beach and in Chesapeake, plus Liberty's base housing. Check the noise and accident potential zone for any address first. Green Run and Salem are about 14 to 16 minutes from the main gate area, and Chesapeake's Greenbrier and Great Bridge about 27 to 30 (estimates, no traffic).

data.q: How does it relate to Norfolk?
data.a: Both are part of the Hampton Roads Navy region. Oceana is the Virginia Beach jet base; Naval Station Norfolk is the huge ship homeport nearby.

data.q: Does Virginia tax my military pay?
data.a: Not if your legal residence is another state: Virginia Tax says that active-duty pay is protected under the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act, though other income, such as a side job, can still be taxed. Virginia taxpayers on extended active duty of more than 90 days can subtract up to $15,000 of military basic pay; the subtraction shrinks as basic pay rises above $15,000 and ends at $30,000.
Oceana falls in MHA VA298 (Norfolk/Portsmouth, which covers Virginia Beach). Use the calculator above for your grade.
